decisions.text: a table alone, formatted in the book's order: the digits the purpose needs, two thin rules, space between rows and columns, the numbers right-aligned to be compared, nothing bold but the title, the unit once in the title (08-12 DP-4, G7.37–G7.45)
digits: each column at its data's own decimals, one number of decimals down each column (G7.37, G6.16)
the unit once, in the title; the cells bare numbers (G7.45)

source.shows: results below the detection limit written “<1” in their cells, aligned as numbers, apart from “(missing)”; the variant, a line chart, is refused: it would draw them as gaps or zero (R0-12)
